Fly Mini, create big

The mini-sized, mega-capable Mini 3 Pro is just as powerful as it is portable — under 249 g, regulation-friendly, and the safest in its series.

1/1.3-inch sensor, 4K/60fps

A 1/1.3-inch sensor shooting 4K/60fps video and 4K/30fps HDR, with 1080p/120fps slow motion and D-Cinelike colour.

Tri-directional sensing, 12 km link

Forward, backward and downward obstacle sensing with APAS 4.0 and Smart RTH, on DJI O3 transmission up to 12 km with a 1080p/30fps live feed.
